negative_controls.detail: non-targeting guides in the same donors and batches

statistical_audit.estimand: the average within-donor difference in mean signature score across this donor population
statistical_audit.identifiability: guides randomised within donor and batch; no donor-condition confounding; the within-donor contrast identifies the effect under exchangeability of cells within donor
statistical_audit.uncertainty: permutation distribution over donor-level means, stratified within donor; cluster structure respected by aggregating before testing
statistical_audit.multiplicity: one prespecified endpoint; no feature-level screen contributes to this claim

power.basis: within-donor sd across six donors at alpha 0.05

statistical_audit.prespecification: endpoint, unit, alpha, and permutation scheme fixed in good_prereg.json before analysis

stated_bounds: six donors, primary macrophages, CRISPRi at 48 hours, this signature, this preprocessing
interpretation: Targeting guides lower the signature relative to non-targeting guides within this screen. Not a population claim.
stated_conditions: that the scope is the screen this was measured in, not the population
that the claim rests on the independence of its upstream units, which the data cannot verify and the design has to argue
that the analysis was carried out at the estimand-matching denominator, naming it
